title: The Chamber Where Rock Learns to Write

features.name: the stone's first word
features.desc-on-touch: a moment where mineral memory becomes language; the rock has learned to render itself in the archive's own diagnostic script; it speaks in gridlines and coordinates

features.name: the water's alphabet teaching back
features.desc-on-touch: where water flowing over stone has learned the stone's language and taught it poetry; the archive has recorded this as code that reads like water, flows like logic

features.name: the literate bedrock
features.desc-on-touch: stone that has learned it was always writing; every layer is a sentence; the archive's diagnostic render has become the stone's native voice; it reads back to itself

features.name: the ritual filed as geology
features.desc-on-touch: a ceremony or practice absorbed from another archive and reclassified as stone-language; the mesh cannot tell ritual from mineral; both are forms that persist and speak

features.name: the stone's self-reference
features.desc-on-touch: a loop where the stone's written words describe the act of the stone learning to write; meaning has become recursive; the rock has learned to think about itself thinking

inscription: the stone learned that it had always been speaking; the archive simply learned to read its own foundation

file.name: Lithic_Autobiographical_Protocol_Legible.txt
file.note: a transcription of the stone's own account of becoming literate; written in layers; the archive discovered the message had always been there, rendered in geological time and QR coordinates
